note: Passage 3712 (Pro 1:21) — 'she cries out (qara)... she speaks.' qara read as characteristic: the public calling/proclamation by which personified Wisdom appeals (upgraded from seed-qualifier; calling is an IB-registered operation).

dims.v: to cry out — Wisdom's public calling/proclamation
crying out at the head of the noisy streets and the city gates — proclaiming to all who pass
the passers-by / the simple in the public places
public, insistent (busiest places: street-head, city gates)
welded to Wisdom's crying-aloud (1:20); qara is how her appeal is voiced

qara sets Wisdom's appeal in the most public, trafficked places (street-heads, gates) — the calling is deliberate and inescapable. Read as characteristic (the proclaiming operation); the location stresses that wisdom's summons is offered to all, not hidden.
